title: Wait, do nursing externs actually get paid? (format C, face cover)

brief.problem: Many students don't know externships are paid (vs unpaid placements), or what a posted rate looks like, so they skip applying or can't plan around school.
hooks: wait, do nursing externs actually get paid?
is a nursing externship paid or unpaid?
how much do nursing externs make?
nursing students, did you know externs get paid?
brief.why: A question any nursing student can have, anywhere; Ontario Health answers it for the program, and one current Ontario posting gives a real rate. 'how much do externs make' was rejected: we have one verified rate, not a range, so it would overpromise. Face cover per the owner's 2026-11-18 test; the stock model is never presented as a student.
brief.payoff: Confirms it's paid (program-level source), shows a real posted rate, and what else to check (hours, status, contract length).
evidence: tiktok-research-2026-11-14 pain_points.md #3 (what an extern is / is it paid; P025) and #7 (money); REPORT F5 (real numbers)

slides.title: wait, do nursing externs actually get paid?
short answer: yes
slides.body: Ontario Health describes the extern program as paid, hands-on work in hospitals. it's a job, not a placement.

slides.label: extern notes 📝
slides.title: one real Ontario example
slides.body: Trillium Health Partners’ extern posting lists $26.756/hr.

slides.title: rates differ by posting
slides.body: each hospital posts its own rate, so compare postings instead of guessing.

slides.title: before you count on the money
slides.body: check the hours, whether it's part-time, how long the contract runs and which shifts you'd work.

slides.title: looking for paid extern postings in ontario?
slides.body: ontarioexterns.ca lists them, checked on each hospital's own careers page.

facts.claim: The Enhanced Extern Program gives nursing and allied health students paid, hands-on work in Ontario hospitals.
facts.quote: By offering paid, hands-on work in hospitals, students get to step into the heart of health care
